events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21st.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released on October 1, 1971.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly now as it did in 1971. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? 25 years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to 007 and over six decades of iconic films, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes. Which Bond actor is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incomparable John Lennon. A voice of a generation, his music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27th.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to 'Monty Python', his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double LP
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' – a sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that pushed boundaries. Which track from this iconic double LP is on your playlist today?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost a true legend. Remembering Freddie Mercury, whose unparalleled voice and stage presence continue to captivate millions. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Evolution of Sound
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your standout track from this pivotal record?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and revolutionary music lives on. What impact did Lennon's music have on you?
